name: Miso Tofu Soup
steps: Warm the water with the kombu over medium heat; remove the kombu just before it boils.
Add the mushrooms and simmer for 4 minutes.
Place the miso in a ladle, dissolve it with some hot broth, and stir it back into the pot. Do not boil after this.
Add the tofu and wakame and warm through for 2 minutes.
note: Miso is high in sodium; use less if you are watching salt, and skip extra salt in the soup.
